notes.title: Brassheart Patch 1.0.1!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello fans of Pola and Pascal! [/h3]
We have just published the first smaller patch for the game. And we are working full steam ahead on a bigger update!

[b][h2]Brasheart v1.0.1 (build: 090425q) [/h2][/b]

[b]Change log:[/b]
[list]
[*] Save and autosave system - minor bugs fixed (after the update some saves may load incorrectly).
[*] Fixed the problem with unnecessary autosave in the main menu
[*] The wire puzzles are more difficult now (previously they could be solved in one move).
[*] Newspaper “Turmoil to the West” - fixed overlapping text
[*] Pascal Voice Over - minor fixes
[*] Cookies in Monaco Corridor - hotspot should no longer appear after eating cookies
[*] Automaton (Monaco) - the hotspot should appear correctly after changing Automaton's position
[*] Clara and Imogen (Monaco) - there should no longer be hotspots left after changing position.
[*] Imogen (Monaco) - the rose shouldn't appear in the character's hair when standing outside
[*] Newspaper (Sulislaw, Airport) - the note's hotspot should no longer appear after it is collected
[*] Skipping dialogues - now you can skip dialogues immediately (no delay)
[*] Valkiria (last scene) - improved dialogue texts
[*] Discord banner with link to game group added to main menu
[*] New Credits scene.
[*] Other minor fixes.
[/list]

[b]We are working on: [/b]
[list]
[*] Additional audio settings - volume bars for ambience and in-game sounds, separating voice-overs from other sounds.
[*] Improved in-game navigation.
[*] Other fixes and improvements reported by players.
[/list]

Stay tuned!

notes.title: Brassheart is an upcoming point and click game where robots may be friend or foe
notes.content:
Upcoming point and click adventure game Brassheart is presumably named for its many sentient robots, made from shiny metal tech spun off from 1920s sensibilities. These AI can be pals, like the chirpy Pascal who accompanies our protagonist Pola, or not so friendly, like the out of control invention that kidnapped its own creator, Pola s father. Whoops. You can listen to Pola explain it herself in the trailer below.

notes.title: Welcome to the Brassheart store page!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35111626/939dd93c46eb9b10b5b279d33c12af1a922bc6d9.jpg[/img]

Add the game to your steam wishlist!

We are very happy to show you Brassheart on Steam with its own page.
You will find a game teaser and a lot of screens in the media board. 
We are very curious to hear your thoughts on the project!

Brassheart is a meticulously designed 2D Point & Click adventure game set in the alternative world of 1920s, inspired by the dieselpunk aesthetics and the classics of the genre. In the world of Brassheart, Pola Zagórska follows the clues that may provide a way to save her father kidnapped by his own invention, a rebellious supermachine, Valkiria. Pola has to set off on a journey and find parts of the mysterious invention scattered all over the world, for they are her only chance to stop the sinister machine, end the era of mechanical terror and save her father.

[b][h1]Prepare to help Pola in her quest by wishlisting game and stay tuned![/h1][/b]
